## Which project

<!-- Project name, and the project ID if you have it (near the top of its public page, like GF-2027-HI-082). If the notice covers several projects, list them. -->

## When

<!-- The date it was said (YYYY-MM-DD). -->

## Who said it, and where

<!-- The source: a department news release, a budget document, a newspaper. Give a link. -->

## What was said

<!-- One short paragraph in your own words. Quote only what the source says; if you are reading something into it (for example, that a release matches this project although it does not name it), say that it is your reading. -->

*What happens next:* a maintainer adds this to the project's record with
your source, and it appears under "What has been reported" on the project's
page once merged. Notices do not wait for the monthly cycle.
